test_title: PYST 72: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:

The theologian referenced** kenosis** in Christological debates.

options.text: The mystic practiced kenosis as spiritual self-emptying.
The sailor recorded kenosis as a form of water purging.
The sermon concluded with a reflection on kenosis.
The tract explored kenosis in Eastern and Western thought.

solution:
The correct answer is "**The sailor recorded kenosis as a form of water purging.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A **homonym** is a word that has the same spelling or pronunciation as another word but a different meaning.
 
• In the given sentence, **"kenosis"** refers to the theological concept of **self-emptying**, especially in Christological discussions. (आत्म-त्याग / आत्म-रि
